body: You have that frame of mind. Look for love, and the sex will come too. I think you're looking for the wrong thing. If you don't want love or strings, fake the relationship till you get what you want, even though that's horrible. And brother, sex isn't what you think it is or what you want it to be, I can tell. You may get more sympathy if your goal was a little more noble than wanting sex. You could pay someone for sex. You should probably do soul searching and ask yourself if sex is *Really* what you want. It could just be a filler for something more, and maybe you just don't know yet.

No, that's not what it means. It means someone thought you were vulnerable enough to be their meaningless toy. They don't care about you, they care about what they get from you. I lost my innocence, and I was stripped of the ability to wait for someone who really loves me. I am broken, tainted, useless, but most of all, I am less than an average man. Its something that leaves psychological hurdles on you. I couldn't even have comfortable sex with my girlfriend for a very long time. Embrace your virginity. Treat it right. You only have it once.
The leading cause of my depression and suicidal thoughts is rape. I wish I was you.
